# Ligas Consulting

> Ligas Consulting (Ligas Consulting Ltd.) is a software consultancy specialising in full-stack TypeScript (React, Node.js, Bun), Java and Kotlin, React Native mobile apps and Liferay, deployed on AWS and Azure. It practises AI-enhanced, human-guided development, delivers solutions together with clients' business teams and trains development teams in modern coding, deployment and operations practice.

## Services

- **Full-stack TypeScript** (main focus): applications with React on the front end and Node.js or Bun on the back end, including micro-frontend architectures that let teams ship independently.
- **Java and Kotlin**: back-end services and web applications with Spring Boot, from architecture decisions through to production.
- **Mobile with React Native**: cross-platform mobile apps with React Native, and Progressive Web Apps where a browser is enough.
- **Liferay**: in-depth Liferay consulting (the founder spent two years as a consultant at Liferay itself), design of large deployments, and development on Liferay.
- **Cloud on AWS and Azure**: cloud deployment architectures with infrastructure as code, containers and automated CI/CD pipelines.
- **Team training**: training and day-to-day mentoring shaped around the client's company that brings engineers up to date across coding, deployment and operations.

Core technologies, in order of focus: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Bun, Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, React Native, Liferay DXP, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Docker, CI/CD.

## AI-enhanced, human-guided development

Ligas Consulting uses AI-assisted development to deliver faster. Experienced engineers guide the work: they set the architecture, review every change and remain accountable for quality. The team also builds AI-powered features into clients' products.

## Clients

Ligas Consulting has worked with Vodafone, T-Mobile Czech Republic, Hays, Capita, Inchcape, Black Sun, Liferay, Proventeq and the Charity Commission for England and Wales.

## Founder

Miroslav Ligas is the founder and lead consultant of Ligas Consulting, founded in 2016. He is a solution architect and Liferay specialist with over 15 years of commercial experience in full-stack TypeScript with React and Node.js, enterprise Java, React Native, large Liferay deployments, AWS infrastructure and AI-assisted development. He stays hands-on in every engagement: designing architectures, writing and reviewing production code and mentoring developers. He studied at the Faculty of Informatics at Masaryk University in Brno and is based in London.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/miroslav-ligas/

## How Ligas Consulting works

- AI-enhanced, human-guided: AI tools speed up delivery while experienced engineers set the direction and review every change.
- Works directly with the client's business team so the solution fits how the business operates.
- Fits every engagement to the client's stack, constraints and people.
- Cares about the whole lifecycle: builds, deployment and keeping systems healthy in production.
